description: Reusable authored-pose direction for paladin player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies holy-knight martial and invocation choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: noble, resolute, weighted, and luminous, with disciplined plate-armored footwork, ceremonial control, and readable sword-led devotion
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's gleaming plate, cape, holy insignia, sword, shield or focus, and exact item count. Keep every item in its original hand and never duplicate, swap, sheath, discard, or transform it.
identity.magicRule: Divine light must use the portrait's established holy palette and originate from the depicted sword, insignia, shield, or prayer hand. Keep halos, rays, and ward accents compact so anatomy and equipment remain readable.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, plate armor, cape, holy insignia, sword, shield or focus, palette, and proportions. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact noble silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered paladin in a resolute consecrated guard facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall paladin motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, plate armor, cape, insignia, palette, proportions, and equipment. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A calm armored breathing loop maintains noble guard, scans the field, and briefly acknowledges the holy insignia before returning.
idle.effectRule: Only a faint contained holy glint on an established insignia or weapon is permitted.
frameDescriptions: resolute guard with holy equipment controlled
measured inhale raising the armored chest
weight shifts forward behind the guard
brief glance toward the established insignia
centered consecrated midpoint
controlled exhale with cape and armor settling
weight shifts rearward as the weapon angle changes
resolute guard flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A disciplined alternating march uses firm contacts, real plate compression, controlled equipment counter-motion, and cape follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No active spell; any established equipment glow remains faint and fixed to its source.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward contact in noble guard
left leg compresses beneath plate armor
passing pose with weapon and free arm balanced
right foot reaches as cape trails
right foot plants with disciplined weight
right leg compresses beneath the armor
passing pose with left knee advancing
left foot reaches into the march

attack.motionDirection: A guarded anticipation becomes a prayer-steady windup, planted radiant slash, decisive contact, cape-led follow-through, and restored noble guard.
attack.effectRule: A short identity-colored holy edge accent may follow the sword only at contact; no projectile or oversized beam.
frameDescriptions: consecrated guard measuring the target
free arm or shield closes while sword draws back
deep prayer-steady windup over the rear leg
committed forward step beginning the slash
radiant sword contact with full torso rotation
noble follow-through as cape and light trail settle
weapon recoils while full guard reforms
recovered consecrated guard

hurt.motionDirection: An impact breaks the guard into a heavy stagger, low devotional brace, armored rise, and resolute recovery.
hurt.effectRule: One compact impact and a few disrupted holy sparks are permitted; no gore, blood, full-body ward, or lost equipment.
frameDescriptions: resolute guard before impact
sharp flinch with equipment held tight
maximum stagger as cape swings wide
forced backward step on deeply bent knees
low brace with insignia or weapon close
faithful push upright through the armor
feet and equipment reset into guard
recovered resolute stance

death.motionDirection: A final impact dims the light, knees buckle under plate, the body lowers through a devotional kneel, collapses sideways, and settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: Holy light fades without gore, blood, dismemberment, or rigid rotation. Keep every item singular and recognizable.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact breaks the consecrated guard
holy accent dims as equipment lowers
both knees buckle into a devotional drop
one knee grounds while torso tips sideways
armored body reaches full ground contact
cape, limbs, and equipment settle low
final fully fallen paladin with light extinguished
same final fallen pose held

cast.motionDirection: The paladin plants in prayer, raises the established holy focus, gathers compact light at the insignia, opens the free hand, releases a protective blessing, and returns to guard.
cast.effectRule: Use one compact holy aura or short blessing pulse in the portrait's palette, sourced visibly from the insignia, weapon, shield, or prayer hand; never hide the body.
frameDescriptions: reverent ready stance
weapon or shield plants as the free hand gathers inward
insignia lifts and begins a contained glow
wide stable stance with prayer hand raised
maximum compact blessing gathered around the established focus
controlled outward release of the holy pulse
light recedes as equipment returns
composed consecrated finish

victory.motionDirection: The paladin acknowledges victory, bows briefly, raises the holy weapon, opens into a luminous shield-or-prayer salute, and holds a noble finish.
victory.effectRule: A compact holy glint or restrained halo may crown the final salute without obscuring the face or equipment.

final triumphant paladin pose held
